high_level_description: The image is a promotional poster for the Malayalam movie "Saruam Maya," directed by Akhil Sathyan and starring Nivin Pauly. The poster is designed with a clean, modern aesthetic, predominantly featuring a light beige background. At the top of the poster, there is a logo for "Firefly Films," indicating the production company behind the film. Below the logo, the title "Saruam Maya" is prominently displayed in large, bold red letters, with the director's name, Akhil Sathyan, written underneath in smaller text. The central part of the poster lists the cast and crew members involved
